note: Declared product lines for unit economics (#34). Rules are evaluated in order and the FIRST match wins, so a more specific line must appear above a broader one. Every shipped product must match a rule; anything left over is reported, never defaulted. Classification reads the LIVE product type from shopify_inventory, not the snapshot copied onto the order line — the snapshot is blank on 2,135 historical line items whose product is typed.

lines.label: Wall calendars
lines.why: Pushed by email and organic, not ads. Kept separate because dimensional weight makes them cost ~$15.37 to ship against $2.96 charged — blending them into planners would flatter the line we do advertise. Listed first because they are typed blank on 217 line items and Stationery on 7, so no product_type identifies them.

lines.label: Planners
lines.why: The advertised physical line. Planner stickers are included as an accessory that normally rides along with a planner.

lines.label: RAD subscription
lines.why: Really Awesome Doodles. Digital: recurring orders ship nothing, and only some initial orders carry a physical welcome item. Plan changes and gifts are matched by title because they carry no product type and no inventory row — they were never products. They are named explicitly rather than inferred from 'untyped with no inventory row', which would also swallow 'Color Happy Test Variants | DO NOT BUY'.

lines.label: Return protection
lines.why: Third-party return insurance sold at checkout (2,866 line items). Revenue with no COGS, no pick, no parcel — folded into planners it would lift that line's margin with money that buys nothing. Marked an add-on: it rides along with a real product, so its presence must not make a basket count as spanning lines.

lines.label: Other physical
lines.why: Notepads, stationery, markers, ties — anything physical the named lines did not claim. Matches the live product type, plus a stock count as a fallback, because a variant with inventory is a physical thing whatever its type says.

lines.label: Digital printables
lines.why: Matched by type only. There is no digital catch-all: a product with no type on the live product record is excluded from every calculation, per Matt — it means a test listing, a never-launched product, or something discontinued years ago. Excluding it is reported with its revenue, never silent.
